replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Cool map {tag=a3f32cc28f9847feaf1107aa945a8bd0}

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✓] Detail
[✘] Room for building & Fighting
[✓] Layers & Structures
[✘] XML
[-] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Recourses 
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

Not many tips but here's a few:

Yes, although I think there is enough structures, I would love to see blocks thickened like add dirt underneath the grass and perhaps add fences above the cobble walls (good detail)

The middle island  seems a little cramped and too close together. I suggest making this distances longer &  extend the platform out and have a few obstacles like wall barracks or something like that. It would make it more appealing and challenging to get there.

If you're looking for the XML Skywars Examples go to http://maps.avicus.net/atlas/SkyWars

Conclusion:

Honestly the map looks great and the simplicity is really appealing. However as suggested above those are the ways I believe the map could be improved. The detail on the building and the variety in island designs are really cool as well! 


Thanks & love the map,

Tiger
